name: Inventory & Vulnerability Scanner
author: derStephan
description: Hardware/software inventory CSV exports, offline NVD vulnerability scanning with honest coverage (drivers/firmware separated), group ratings, scheduled notifications, printable reports, opt-in winget auto-updates incl. fleet-wide per-package update/uninstall, on-demand OS updates / release upgrades, and software deployment: install MSI/EXE/DEB/RPM packages on selected devices or whole locations (reconnect queue, SHA-256 verified, never an automatic reboot). Updates, OS Updates and Deploy live on their own tabs; Settings (incl. the CPE mapping table) is last.
